provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: byte-identical duplicate of multi_vessel_morphology/plot_wave.m; in this directory the fdir target matches the case name, suggesting this is the original and the multi_vessel copy is the stale one — not decidable from file contents alone

tight_subplot is required but, unlike the cohesive case directory, no copy is co-located here as far as this file shows; 2680*1000 mg/L conversion provenance unstated; variable min shadows the builtin

audit_member_text: Wet cells with CH=0 pass the mask at L41 but become -Inf in `log10(CH*2680*1000.0)` at L69; negative/sentinel concentrations produce non-real/NaN values. No positivity floor or invalid-value mask supports the finite [0,2.999] color range.

Displayed times are stored separately in `min` (L20,L58) instead of derived from nfile (L18); no cadence parameter or array-length check prevents silent mislabeling. The name `min` also shadows MATLAB's built-in minimum function.
The only print statement is commented at L89, so despite the file's batch-like construction it produces no image file unless run interactively and manually saved.
The absolute external-drive path is unchecked; field shapes and fixed plot axes are not validated against the loaded grid.
